description: Read-only access to your local Zotero library and the current Zotero selection, attached to every prompt.

interface.longDescription: Read your Zotero library and attach the current selection to each prompt. When other sources cannot retrieve full text, download research PDFs through Zotero using your campus network or VPN access. Downloads are temporary files; the library stays unchanged. Some publishers may open a CAPTCHA window in Zotero.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the paper I have open in Zotero
Find papers in my Zotero library about this topic
List the annotations I made in the current PDF
